nivrolet: Outside, the cross on Nivrolet, a luminous symbol of faith, pointed steadfastly to heaven.

On the utmost peak of the Mont du Nivrolet, which towers east of Chambéry, directly opposite the Chaîne de l’Epine, gleams an immense cross twenty-five meters high, visible from all the surrounding country.
